settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.sidebar_text: Our team of clinical specialists is available to assist you with tailored advice.

settings.question: Is the Neoglyn Lumina safe for all skin types?
settings.answer: Yes. The Neoglyn Lumina uses non-UV LED light and micro-pulse technology that is FDA-cleared and dermatologist-tested to be safe for all skin tones and types, including sensitive skin.

settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: Clinical studies show visible improvements in skin tone and acne reduction within 2 weeks of consistent use (5 minutes daily). Significant reductions in fine lines and deeper wrinkles typically occur after 4 to 8 weeks.

settings.question: Can I use my own serums with the device?
settings.answer: While you can use other water-based serums, our Conductive Repair Serum is specifically formulated to maximize the micro-pulse conductivity and LED light penetration. Oil-based serums will block the optical delivery entirely.

settings.question: What is the warranty policy?
settings.answer: Every Neoglyn device comes with a comprehensive 2-year warranty covering any manufacturing defects. We also offer a 60-day money-back guarantee if you are not completely satisfied with your clinical results.
